{{Top}}
{{Quote|I don't want to give up on her, but she's been gone a month.|[[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], about his kidnapped [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|wife]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The term '''standard month''', also known more simply as '''month''', referred to a [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standardized]] period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted, in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], approximately 30 days, though it differed between the twelve months of a [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]].<ref name="Holonet">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]] and its articles, combined with the dates provided in the ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', redefine the calendar system to have twelve months in a year, and all but the sixth, eight, and twelfth months are confirmed to have either 30 or 31 days.</ref> The [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] lasted for one month.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The lifespans of people, especially infants, would occasionally be measured in months instead of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I||Billaba, Depa}}</ref> In some forms of the calendar, a month was measured by 35 [[Standard day/Legends|days]] (7 [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of 5 days).<ref name="RPG">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
